title_en: At Urban Gate Astir, 7 parking spaces for sale, ideal opportunity for investment!!
description_en: At Urban Gate Astir, 7 parking spaces for sale, ideal opportunity for investment!!! All posts are located on the -2nd floor, and they are one after the other. Their total surface is 140.6 m2. The Urban Gate complex is a residential building of 6-10 floors with 2 floors of underground parking and stands out for the high-quality works starting from the hydraulic-electrical installations, ventilated facades, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows equipped with shutters, rest spaces and green spaces around the complex which will be carried out by the "Urban Planning & Development shpk" company.
